All three teams announced have NBA ownership groups; the Detroit and Cleveland teams will play at the NBA arenas that currently exist, while Philadelphia is planning on a new building that will be completed hopefully by 2030. Cunningham raised her concerns with the expansion plan during Tuesday's shootaround before the Fever's 74-59 victory over the Minnesota Lynx in the WNBA Commissioner's Cup final. "You want to listen to your players, too," she said.
